subject: Social Habits
title: Show what we know again
objectives: Children will show Term 2 learning through play stations.
Teachers will gather evidence for every child’s Term 2 record.
content: Revising family and friends, manners and honesty, and helping and respect, with end-of-term records.
teachingActivities: Keep every activity familiar and joyful; observe quietly during play; record what children can do; share records with parents in plain language with a strength, a next step and a home idea.
learnerActivities: Show learning from the term through play stations and a celebration.
assessment: Observe and record each child’s Term 2 social learning.
expectedOutcomes: Completes familiar social tasks with growing independence.
Each child has an observation record for Term 2.

lessons.title: Revising family and friends
lessons.subject: Social Habits
objectives: Children will revisit family, friends and listening through games.
lessons.previousKnowledge: Children have learnt about family, friends, listening, sorry, helping, honesty, caring, eating manners and respect.
lessons.starter: Sing the family song and say "Today we play our favourite family and friend games."
teacherActivities: Play family in the play house.
Let each child choose a game.
learnerActivities: Child rolls the ball to a friend.
presentation: Step 1. Teacher: Play the family card game. Children: Child names family members.
Step 2. Teacher: Play family in the play house. Children: Child plays a family role.
Step 3. Teacher: Play ball with a friend. Children: Child rolls the ball to a friend.
Step 4. Teacher: Let each child choose a game. Children: Child chooses and plays.

practical.title: Family and friends games
steps: Children play each for four minutes.
practical.safety: Supervise each area and keep floors clear. Be sensitive to every family situation.

differentiation.support: Play with the child and one game.
differentiation.extension: Ask the child to lead a game.

assessment.method: Observe each child during the practical activity and note Emerging, Developing, Secure or Exceeding on the class record. Ask the questions below one to one or in a small group.

lessons.conclusion: Wave goodbye and say "I love my family."
lessons.homeConnection: Keep talking about family and friends.
teacherReflection: Which children could show "revisit family, friends and listening through games" without help, and who needs another turn tomorrow?
What did the children say or do that I did not expect, and how will I use it in the next lesson?
Which resource or instruction worked best, and what would I change before I teach this again?

lessons.title: Revising manners and honesty
lessons.subject: Social Habits
objectives: Children will revisit sorry, thank you, truth and eating manners through games.
lessons.previousKnowledge: Children have learnt about family, friends, listening, sorry, helping, honesty, caring, eating manners and respect.
lessons.starter: Say "Today we play our manners and truth games."
teacherActivities: Play puppet sorry and it is okay.
Play true or not true with pictures.
Play snack time with toy food.
Let each child choose a game.
learnerActivities: Child says sorry or it is okay.
Child says true or not true.
Child says please and thank you.
presentation: Step 1. Teacher: Play puppet sorry and it is okay. Children: Child says sorry or it is okay.
Step 2. Teacher: Play true or not true with pictures. Children: Child says true or not true.
Step 3. Teacher: Play snack time with toy food. Children: Child says please and thank you.
Step 4. Teacher: Let each child choose a game. Children: Child chooses and plays.

practical.title: Manners and truth games
steps: Children play each for four minutes.
practical.safety: Supervise each area and use toy food only. Keep floors clear.

differentiation.support: Play beside the child and prompt words.
differentiation.extension: Ask the child to be the teacher puppet.

assessment.method: Observe each child during the practical activity and note Emerging, Developing, Secure or Exceeding on the class record. Ask the questions below one to one or in a small group.

questions.question: What do we say when we hurt someone?

lessons.conclusion: Wave goodbye and say thank you.
lessons.homeConnection: Keep using manners and truth at home.

lessons.title: Social stations
lessons.subject: Social Habits
objectives: Teachers will gather evidence of each child’s Term 2 social learning at play stations.
lessons.previousKnowledge: Children have learnt about family, friends, listening, sorry, helping, honesty, caring, eating manners and respect.
lessons.starter: Say "Today we play at six stations and show what we know."
teacherActivities: Set up six stations: family, friends, listening, sorry, helping and respect.
Observe each child at two stations and record what they do.
presentation: Step 1. Teacher: Set up six stations: family, friends, listening, sorry, helping and respect. Children: Children rotate every three minutes.
Step 2. Teacher: Observe each child at two stations and record what they do. Children: Children play at stations.
Step 3. Teacher: Take photographs and make notes. Children: Children tidy at the signal.

practical.title: Social stations
practical.safety: Supervise each station with an adult or helper. Keep floors clear and use large safe toys.

differentiation.support: Provide an adult partner and stay at familiar stations.
differentiation.extension: Ask a confident child to show friends how a station works.

assessment.method: Observe and record Emerging, Developing, Secure or Exceeding for: names family; plays with friends; listens and follows instructions; says sorry; helps; shows respect.

expectedOutcomes: Shows familiar social skills at stations
lessons.conclusion: Say well done to everyone and wave goodbye.
lessons.homeConnection: Play a favourite game at home during the holiday.

What did the children say or do that I did not expect, and how will I use it in the next lesson?
Which resource or instruction worked best, and what would I change before I teach this again?

lessons.title: Revising helping and respect
lessons.subject: Social Habits
objectives: Children will revisit helping, caring for things and respect through games.
lessons.previousKnowledge: Children have learnt about family, friends, listening, sorry, helping, honesty, caring, eating manners and respect.
teacherActivities: Choose helpers and give each a job.
Play helper role play with hats.
Say thank you to all helpers.
presentation: Step 1. Teacher: Choose helpers and give each a job. Children: Child does a job.
Step 2. Teacher: Play helper role play with hats. Children: Child greets a helper.
Step 3. Teacher: Water the plant together. Children: Child waters the plant.
Step 4. Teacher: Say thank you to all helpers. Children: Children say thank you.

practical.title: Helping games
practical.safety: Use child-size tools and supervise closely. Keep floors dry and clear.

differentiation.support: Do the job together with the child.
differentiation.extension: Ask the child to organise a job for friends.

assessment.method: Observe each child during the practical activity and note Emerging, Developing, Secure or Exceeding on the class record. Ask the questions below one to one or in a small group.

questions.question: What do we say to helpers?

lessons.conclusion: Wave goodbye and say well done.
lessons.homeConnection: Keep giving small jobs at home.
teacherReflection: Which children could show "revisit helping, caring for things and respect through games" without help, and who needs another turn tomorrow?

lessons.title: Term celebration and records
lessons.subject: Social Habits
objectives: Children will celebrate Term 2 with songs, and teachers will complete each child’s Term 2 record.
lessons.previousKnowledge: Children have learnt about family, friends, listening, sorry, helping, honesty, caring, eating manners and respect.
lessons.starter: Say "Today we celebrate our term. Let us sing our favourite songs."
teacherActivities: Sing favourite songs and rhymes with actions.
Give each child a sticker and say their name.
Complete each child’s record and next step.
learnerActivities: Child waves and says thank you.
presentation: Step 1. Teacher: Sing favourite songs and rhymes with actions. Children: Children sing and do actions.
Step 2. Teacher: Give each child a sticker and say their name. Children: Child waves and says thank you.
Step 3. Teacher: Complete each child’s record and next step. Children: Children play quietly.

practical.title: Celebration circle
practical.safety: Check for allergies before any snack and use non-toxic stickers. Keep the floor clear and supervise all play.

differentiation.support: Hold the child’s hand and sing together.
differentiation.extension: Ask the child to choose the last song.

assessment.method: Complete each child’s Term 2 record from the term’s observations. Note a strength, a next step and a home idea for parents.

questions.question: What do you like to do?

lessons.conclusion: Wave goodbye and say "See you next term."
lessons.homeConnection: Share the Term 2 record and keep practising over the holiday.
